title: Compile-Gated Lean Proof Refactoring with Enterprise Agent Practices: A Model per Step under a US\$3 Cap, Followed by Programmatic Rewrite Rules
abstract: arXiv:2611.13011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Our closed-track entry (Arena username Vexorium-Agent) scored 86.31 points on the final board (L = 77.07, H = 81.86, Z = 100) over the 60 final problems, against 33.33 for the reference proofs, 8th at the deadline (top: 92.57), for US\$166.33 at list prices with every call counted (per problem: mean US\$2.772, at most US\$2.874; US\$3 cap). Three practices carry the entry. First, each paid stage runs the model that measured best per dollar for it among the 9 we tested in our own harness: GPT-6.1 Sol the early sessions, GPT-6.1 Terra the later ones and the tail at 70% of Sol's cost per turn, and Gemini 4 Argon the review and repair; Sol also runs the style rewrite. Second, what our development and research runs learned ships as compiler-checked programmatic rewrite rules rather than prompt text (+0.93 points from rules fixed before the release; +0.26 and +0.30, in sample, from passes built or switched on after the release). translated_title: 编译门控的 Lean 证明重构与企业级智能体实践：在每题3美元上限下每步选用一个模型，随后进行程序化重写规则
translated_abstract: 我们参加封闭赛道的作品（Arena 用户名 Vexorium-Agent）在60道决赛题目上的最终榜单得分为86.31分（L = 77.07，H = 81.86，Z = 100），相比之下参考证明为33.33分，截止时排名第8（最高分：92.57），按标价并计入每一次调用的总费用为166.33美元（每题平均2.772美元，最高2.874美元；3美元上限）。三项实践支撑了这一成绩。第一，每个付费阶段使用我们在自建测试框架中测试的9个模型中“单位美元效果最佳”的模型：早期会话使用 GPT-6.1 Sol，后期会话与收尾阶段使用 GPT-6.1 Terra（其每轮成本为 Sol 的70%），审查与修复使用 Gemini 4 Argon；风格重写也由 Sol 完成。第二，我们在开发与研究运行中习得的经验以经过编译器校验的程序化重写规则的形式交付，而非提示词文本（发布前固定的规则带来+0.93分；发布后构建或启用的 pass 在样本内分别带来+0.26和+0.30分）。第三，每个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种“每步选用性价比最优模型、单题成本严格控制在3美元上限内”的企业级智能体实践，并将开发中积累的经验固化为经编译器校验的程序化重写规则，最终以86.31分（总花费166.33美元）在 Lean 证明重构竞赛中获得第8名。
en_tdlr: The paper applies enterprise agent practices to compile-gated Lean proof refactoring—running the best value-per-dollar model for each stage under a US$3 per-problem cap and shipping learned improvements as compiler-checked programmatic rewrite rules rather than prompts—achieving 8th place with 86.31 points for a total of US$166.33.
